source_document.title: Trained Leader Requirements - Unit and Other Positions

sources.citation: Scouting America, Trained Leader Requirements - Unit and Other Positions
Scouting America, Position Trained Requirements, June 2025

provenance.notes: New Member Coordinator (registration code NM) is a unit committee position that replaced Parent Coordinator and Unit Membership Chair. Position trained = Youth Protection Training plus New Member Coordinator training (SCO_535 Welcome Class + SCO_536 Elements of the Job); the requirement is the same across unit types.
